name: stonehenge
attribution: Geometry and sculpture originally authored for Low Poly Earth; dimensions and reference notes credited in the local evidence file.
description: Present sarsen ruins with seventeen circle uprights, six outer lintels, three complete trilithons, fallen stones, bluestones and northeast Heel Stone.

audit.grounding_note: Raw terrain is unchanged. Stable rigid components are positioned against surveyed elevation, with their buried supports extended to meet it. Small carvings and irregular stone profiles are authored approximations; see evidence.

geometry: original metric interpretation of cited references; estimates identified in source notes
